trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The paragraph closing the 'lepton tower' section restated, in weaker words, the two things the two preceding lines had just said: 'The recurrence relations underlying this lepton tower are elementary identities in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$' duplicated the immediately preceding 'The recurrence is exact in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$', and 'satisfy a standard induction over $n$ via the quadratic Hecke relation' duplicated the section-1 derivation that ends 'This completes the induction.' It carried no fact not already on the page.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes:
FIXED inline (2 sentences, pure prose, both facts stated verbatim elsewhere in the same block, no meaning change). before -> 'The recurrence is exact in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$. The decimal values are evaluations at $q = q_0$.

The recurrence relations underlying this lepton tower are elementary identities in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$. The Morgan-Voyce sequences $\{a_n\}$ and $\{b_n\}$ satisfy a standard induction over $n$ via the quadratic Hecke relation.

## Structural content' ; after -> 'The recurrence is exact in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$. The decimal values are evaluations at $q = q_0$.

## Structural content'. Math delimiters re-checked after the edit: 1 display pair, balanced inline. Separately: the block also spelled the name 'Morgan-Voyce' with a hyphen against 'Morgan--Voyce' in the parent proposition; the deletion removes that inconsistency incidentally. See the Morgan--Voyce misattribution finding recorded on prop:lepton-continuant-recurrence — the sequences are the Fibonacci polynomials, not Morgan--Voyce.
